name: fitweb-gate-v8-1
prompt: Create a new image. Image 1 is the current render. Keep its camera angle, framing, miniature architectural scale-model style, soft warm light and beige background, and keep the whole FRONT part exactly as in image 1: the gate canopy with FORTEASIA INDUSTRIAL TOWNSHIP lettering, the left guard block with glass cabin, FIT logo and plaque, the right pillar with the Forteasia logo, exactly one boom barrier at the guard cabin, flags, grass, workers, the container truck, tipper truck, pickup and forklift at the gate, and the wide six-lane main road outside the gate with its T-junction and turn arrows. Image 1 has a serious error that you must fix: the area behind the gate looks like a raised slab floating at the height of the canopy roof. Remove that slab completely. Behind the gate everything must stand on ONE flat continuous ground, at exactly the same level as the road under the gate. The township road passes under the canopy and continues straight on the ground into the far distance with its green median and trees. Image 2 is a top-down site plan: follow it. On the LEFT of the township road, well behind the gate, ONE factory; on the RIGHT, well behind the gate, ONE warehouse that is clearly SMALLER than the factory (about two thirds of its length and lower). Both stand on the ground, further away than the gate so they look smaller through perspective, and both are fully behind the gate: no building, yard or slab touches, overlaps or lines up with the canopy roof, and there is visible ground and road between the canopy and the buildings. Each building's long side runs parallel to the township road and its main facade with the loading docks faces the road, with a paved truck yard at ground level between the facade and the road, joined to the road by a driveway. The factory has a saw-tooth roof with skylights and solar panels, an office block at its front corner, roller-shutter bays with warm light, a truck backed into a bay, a forklift, pallets and workers. The warehouse has loading docks, one open with warm light, a container truck at a dock, a forklift and a few workers. Nothing else. Do not draw the plan's labels or colours. No text other than the existing gate lettering and logos, no watermark.
